# montecarlo_self_hosted_env_var_credentials (Resource)

Environment variable credentials name the environment variable on your deployment that holds a connection's credentials. Monte Carlo stores the name, not the value.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake` or `bigquery`, or one of your custom connector types. Fixed once created.
- `env_var_name` (String) Name of the environment variable on the deployment that holds the connection's credentials. Must start with `MCD_`.

### Optional

- `bq_project_id` (String) BigQuery project the connection reads from. Only for a BigQuery connection.
- `kms_key_id` (String) AWS KMS key the variable's value is encrypted with. Omit it for a value stored in the clear.
- `sql_warehouse_id` (String) Databricks SQL warehouse the connection runs queries on. Required for a `databricks-sql-warehouse` or `databricks-metastore-sql-warehouse` connection.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
